router.question: What is the person asking the smart home voice assistant to do?
router.no_call: something other than a home device function, such as a question or small talk

lights.description: switch the lights on or off, change their brightness or colour

action.question: Does the user want the lights switched on, switched off, made brighter, made dimmer or changed colour?

options.brighter: the lights made brighter, at a higher brightness
options.dimmer: the lights made dimmer, at a lower brightness
options.color: the lights changed to a particular colour

room.question: Which room's lights does the user mean?

stated.question: Does the user say which room's lights, such as the kitchen, the bedroom, the porch or the whole house?
stated.true: names a room or the whole house

options.porch: the porch at the front door
options.all: the lights in every room of the house

color.question: Which colour does the user want the lights to be?

stated.question: Does the user name a colour for the lights, such as red, blue or white?

vacuum.description: start the robot vacuum or hoover cleaning the floors

room.question: Which room does the user want vacuumed?

stated.question: Does the user say where to vacuum, such as the kitchen, the bedroom, the hallway or the whole house?
stated.true: names a room or the whole house
stated.false: does not say where to vacuum

options.porch: the porch at the front door

coffee.description: make a cup of coffee with the coffee machine

drink.question: Which kind of coffee does the user want?

stated.question: Does the user name a kind of coffee, such as an espresso, a latte or a cappuccino?
stated.false: asks for coffee without saying which kind

options.regular: a plain ordinary cup of coffee
options.espresso: a small strong shot of coffee
options.cappuccino: a coffee with a thick foamy milk top
options.latte: a mild milky coffee made with lots of steamed milk
options.americano: a long black coffee, a shot topped up with hot water

plug.description: switch the smart plug or wemo socket on or off

action.question: Does the user want the smart plug switched on or off?

options.on: the socket switched on, supplying power
options.off: the socket switched off, cutting the power

speaker.description: change the speaker volume or mute it

action.question: Does the user want the speaker louder, quieter or silenced?
